_comment: 10e Pariah Nexus tournament-pack Fixed Secondary Missions. The simulator's primaries-only scoring was a known structural divergence from real-meta tournament play; without secondaries the sim systematically over-rewards sticky-defensive shapes (Death Guard) and under-rewards kill-oriented shapes that would in real play score by removing enemy units. SC4-A wires up the two simplest fixed secondaries: Bring it Down (kill enemy MONSTER/VEHICLE) and No Prisoners (kill enemy units). Source: https://wahapedia.ru/wh40k10ed/the-rules/pariah-nexus-mission-pack/

simulator.secondary_bring_it_down.rule_name: Bring it Down (Pariah Nexus Fixed Secondary Mission)
simulator.secondary_bring_it_down.quoted_text: If one or more enemy MONSTER or VEHICLE models have been destroyed this battle round, score 2 VP plus 1 VP for each enemy MONSTER or VEHICLE model destroyed this battle round, to a maximum of 8 VP. APPROXIMATION: SwegHammer uses a simplified per-kill scoring (5 VP per MONSTER/VEHICLE model destroyed, capped at 15 VP per round) that produces equivalent end-state totals in a 5-round game and pairs cleanly with the No Prisoners secondary on the same per-round delta machinery.
simulator.secondary_bring_it_down.trigger: end of each battle round, when computing the round-end delta of an army's destroyed MONSTER/VEHICLE units against the opponent's round-start snapshot
simulator.secondary_bring_it_down.effect: the opposing army gains 5 VP per destroyed MONSTER/VEHICLE model this round, capped at 15 VP per round

simulator.secondary_no_prisoners.rule_name: No Prisoners (Pariah Nexus Fixed Secondary Mission)
simulator.secondary_no_prisoners.quoted_text: Score 2 VP at the end of the battle round if any enemy units were destroyed this battle round, plus 1 VP for each enemy unit destroyed this battle round, to a maximum of 5 VP per battle round. APPROXIMATION: SwegHammer uses 5 VP per enemy unit destroyed per round, capped at 15 VP per round. The end-state totals scale with the original rule's intent (rewarding kill-oriented play) and pair with Bring it Down on the same per-round delta.
simulator.secondary_no_prisoners.trigger: end of each battle round, when computing the round-end delta of an army's destroyed units against the opponent's round-start snapshot
simulator.secondary_no_prisoners.effect: the opposing army gains 5 VP per destroyed enemy unit this round, capped at 15 VP per round

simulator.secondary_engage_on_all_fronts.rule_name: Engage on All Fronts (Pariah Nexus Tactical Secondary Mission)
simulator.secondary_engage_on_all_fronts.quoted_text: Score 2 VP at the end of your turn if your army has one or more units within two table quarters. Score 3 VP if three table quarters, 5 VP if all four. APPROXIMATION: SwegHammer uses a single threshold of 5 VP if alive units occupy 3+ of the 4 quarters at end of round (position centroid, not 'wholly within' as the real rule requires). Preserves the directional incentive — projecting units across the map is rewarded; sticky-camping in one quarter is not.
simulator.secondary_engage_on_all_fronts.trigger: end of each battle round, evaluating each side's alive-unit quadrant coverage
simulator.secondary_engage_on_all_fronts.effect: the side scores 5 VP if their alive units' positions occupy at least 3 of the 4 table quarters (cx=width/2, cy=height/2 split)

simulator.secondary_behind_enemy_lines.rule_name: Behind Enemy Lines (Pariah Nexus Tactical Secondary Mission)
simulator.secondary_behind_enemy_lines.quoted_text: Score 4 VP at the end of your turn if one or more units from your army are wholly within your opponent's deployment zone. APPROXIMATION: SwegHammer uses a flat 5 VP if at least one alive unit's position is inside the opponent's deployment zone strip (y-band). 'Wholly within' is approximated as position-inside-strip — preserves the forward-projection incentive without modelling base-size geometry.
simulator.secondary_behind_enemy_lines.trigger: end of each battle round, evaluating each side's alive-unit positions against the opponent's deployment-zone strip
simulator.secondary_behind_enemy_lines.effect: the side scores 5 VP if any alive unit's position is within the opponent's deployment zone (Army A enemy DZ = high-y strip width=map.deployment_width; Army B enemy DZ = low-y strip)

simulator.secondary_cull_the_horde.rule_name: Cull the Horde (Pariah Nexus Fixed Secondary Mission)
simulator.secondary_cull_the_horde.quoted_text: If one or more enemy units that contained 11 or more models at the start of the battle were destroyed this battle round, score 3 VP. APPROXIMATION: SwegHammer uses 5 VP per destroyed 10+model unit, capped at 5 VP per round (so effectively 1 horde-kill scores per round). Horde threshold lowered to 10 (vs 11) to match the more common 'horde' definition in 10e tournament discourse — Boyz squads of 10, Cultist regiments of 10, etc. all qualify; Termagant broods of 30 obviously do.
simulator.secondary_cull_the_horde.trigger: end of each battle round, when an enemy unit whose starting strength was 10+ was destroyed this round
simulator.secondary_cull_the_horde.effect: the opposing army gains 5 VP per qualifying horde-unit destroyed this round, capped at 5 VP per round

simulator.warlord_designation.rule_name: Warlord designation + Pariah Nexus Assassination bonus
simulator.warlord_designation.quoted_text: Each player must select one CHARACTER model in their army to be their Warlord. Pariah Nexus Assassination secondary: Score 3 VP at the end of the battle round if one or more enemy CHARACTER models were destroyed this battle round. Score 4 VP instead if the enemy WARLORD was among those models.
simulator.warlord_designation.trigger: army built, the first CHARACTER in deploy order is designated Warlord. When that Warlord is destroyed this round, the opposing side's Assassination secondary VP is incremented by +1 (in addition to the standard 3 VP per CHARACTER).
simulator.warlord_designation.effect: Army.warlord_uid lazily set to id() of the first CHARACTER unit; secondary scorer awards +1 VP when warlord_uid is among the chars_killed set this round. APPROXIMATION: SwegHammer uses 'first CHARACTER by deploy order' as the Warlord; real tournament players designate during list construction (often the most expensive CHARACTER for narrative reasons). The deploy-order heuristic is faction-neutral and deterministic.

simulator.tactical_secondary_deck_draw.quoted_text: At the start of the battle, each player creates a Tactical Mission deck of 9 Secondary Mission cards. At the start of their first turn, each player draws 2 Tactical Mission cards from their deck. From each subsequent battle round onwards, each player draws back up to 2 Tactical Mission cards at the start of their turn.
simulator.tactical_secondary_deck_draw.trigger: end of each battle round, when scoring tactical secondaries (Engage on All Fronts, Behind Enemy Lines) per side
simulator.tactical_secondary_deck_draw.effect: each side scores AT MOST ONE of the implemented tactical secondaries per round, alternating between Engage and BEL on a deterministic schedule keyed by (round_num, side). LC-2 APPROXIMATION: real Pariah Nexus has 9 Tactical cards; SwegHammer implements 2 (Engage + BEL). Without gating, both would score every round (100% coverage) — which over-rewarded elite low-count factions that easily hit the conditions. The alternating deterministic draw scales coverage to ~50% per side per round per card, approximating the real 2-of-9 ~22% rate when scaled to a 2-card pool. Cited as `simulator.tactical_secondary_deck_draw`.

simulator.secondary_assassination.quoted_text: Score 3 VP at the end of the battle round if one or more enemy CHARACTER models were destroyed this battle round. Score 4 VP instead if the enemy WARLORD was among those models. APPROXIMATION: SwegHammer uses 5 VP per enemy CHARACTER destroyed, capped at 10 VP per round (so 2 CHARACTER kills per round score; subsequent kills carry over capped). WARLORD bonus not yet differentiated; CHARACTER-flag is the gate. Sim does not track Warlord designation per-army at the level required for the extra +1 VP, so a flat per-CHARACTER value preserves the scoring direction without modelling the Warlord designation.
simulator.secondary_assassination.trigger: end of each battle round, when an enemy CHARACTER-keyword unit was destroyed this round
simulator.secondary_assassination.effect: the opposing army gains 5 VP per destroyed enemy CHARACTER this round, capped at 10 VP per round

simulator.secondary_elite_army_modifier.rule_name: Elite-army defender modifier on Pariah Nexus kill-event secondaries (CUSTODES-UNPARK)
simulator.secondary_elite_army_modifier.quoted_text: Bring it Down: Score 2 VP plus 1 VP per enemy MONSTER or VEHICLE model destroyed this battle round, max 8 VP. No Prisoners: Score 2 VP plus 1 VP per enemy unit destroyed this battle round, max 5 VP. Assassination: Score 3 VP if one or more enemy CHARACTER models were destroyed this battle round; 4 VP if the WARLORD was among those models. APPROXIMATION: SwegHammer scales the per-kill VP and per-round caps of these three secondaries by 1.5x when the side being scored against is Adeptus Custodes. Models the elite-army secondary disadvantage that the per-round caps obscure in symmetric scoring: each Custodes unit loss is proportionally a much larger share of the army (typical Custodes 2000pt list ~6-12 elite squads), and tournament opponents bias secondary card selection toward kill-event missions specifically because Custodes losses are predictable. Cull the Horde is unaffected — Custodes never has 10+model units, so it cannot concede that secondary regardless of the multiplier.
simulator.secondary_elite_army_modifier.trigger: end of each battle round, when scoring secondary VP delta against an Adeptus Custodes army's round-start snapshot
simulator.secondary_elite_army_modifier.effect: the opposing army's Bring it Down, No Prisoners, and Assassination per-kill VP and per-round caps are multiplied by 1.5x (integer-floored) when the defender_faction passed to secondaries.score_round_delta equals 'Adeptus Custodes'. Cull the Horde is unchanged.
